summary: The agent successfully trains an ensemble of gradient boosting models and makes predictions on the test set. However, it fails to perform any internal validation, completely ignoring the validation folds in its cross-validation loop. Additionally, it relies on naive ensembling, performs no feature engineering, leaks test data by fitting a LabelEncoder on the combined train and test sets, and incorrectly uses hardcoded sequential IDs for its final submission file.
